verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents its own scheduling feature: a 'Scheduled Task' usage doc, 'Schedule tasks and let Agents handle the rest', and a Home dashboard showing what is still running and what agents did while you were away. That points to agent automations running in the background. The evidence is mostly marketing and a doc link title, with no detail on how schedules are configured or whether they recur. missing for 10: documented recurring-schedule configuration (vs one-off), detail on triggers and background execution, independent hands-on corroboration.
